steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Why are you leaning against the wall in a weird pose? I thought I was looking at a statue.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: You could have heard my joints crack if you came in earlier.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I should pay a visit to an artificer, see if I can't get some cushioning for my waist.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I'm not sure the gun-knight armorsmiths take into account the special needs of the elderly.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Young gun-knights need it too! It helps mitigate the recoil from our guns!

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: The Nativity is tomorrow. How are preparations at the Shrine of Nurtury?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The mother is in stable condition. Andoain has taken good care of her. She will give birth to a healthy, beautiful infant tomorrow.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Wiš'adel and the Kazdelian delegation, the Twin Empresses and the Leithanian delegation, the delegation from the Ægir Institute of Development Planning, the Tianshi delegation led by Yan's Envoy of Ceremonial Rites...

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Tomorrow, all the visitors to the Holy City are invited to the Shrine of Nurtury to witness the birth of a new life.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Why did you need me, then, if everything is in order?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Our newest cardinal...

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Lemuen?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: She came to see the Matriarch. I'm wondering—

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Did she 'happen' to pass by as she was investigating the bombings, 'drop in' to take a look, and then propose to provide help to the Shrine of Nurtury on a 'whim'?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: At first, I thought she came because of the attack on Andoain. But when I saw the look on her face after she saw the Matriarch... it is clear that she has suspicions.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I thought I quelled those.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Lemuen possesses a keen edge that few others have, especially when focused on a single matter. There is certainly no better fit for a cardinal of the Seventh Tribunal.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: At the same time, there is also no worse fit. More often than not, she relies solely on her own judgment when it comes to where she will focus her attention.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Do we need to be on guard against her?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: You make us sound like some evil organization plotting to overthrow Laterano.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Who is to say?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: For some, the future that we usher in will overturn life as they know it.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Our empathy, our kindred and family, even the concept of 'Sankta' itself... existing limitations will be cast aside.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: This should have been the predetermined end of Laterano's path, but the path has gone on far too long.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Some people take the accidents that happened in the process as the norm, and now they can't accept the predetermined end.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: That is correct.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: We should prepare early.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I'll deal with Lemuen. You head back to the Shrine of Nurtury and get ready for tomorrow's ceremony.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: May the Lord's blessings be with this city.
The red-headed Sankta runs through a forest of white and blue, like a tiny flame flickering in the rain.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That cloud on that comfort bell is almost the size of Croissant's van... and a cradle large enough to hold two cargo containers...
The clouds hanging upon the comfort bells seem to block out the sunlight, and the hands holding up the cradles reaching towards the clouds.
In this place, every living thing appears small and insignificant.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What the heck...?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It feels so empty and quiet, but more than half of these nurseries are occupied...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Children, outsiders, even Fallen Angels... the Nurturers are busy. Looks like they've been living here for a while.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Didn't they say most of the facilities are empty and will only open to the public when that ceremony is done?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's not true at all!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I have to recover the bombs!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I thought I could stop the ceremony by blowing up the venue, but this place is full of people...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: To think I went through all that effort to slip past the guards...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: ...I wish the girls were here.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Texas could've knocked out all the guards and dragged them outside, or Croissant could've barged into the rooms and packed up everyone inside...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Or I could just get the boss to do a meet-and-greet opposite the ceremony to draw everybody's attention...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ugh, forget it. There's no time, I gotta get to work...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'll take these bombs apart and think of another way—
It'll be easier if you cut the blue wire first.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Whah...?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: When did you get back?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: El.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: An entirely unremarkable apartment, except for the fact that its roof offers a perfect view of the plaza in front of the Shrine of Nurtury.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Is that why you chose to hide here, Arturia?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Another happy reunion.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: And much sooner than I expected.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You did not attempt to conceal your trail.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The paper dragonfly was a clear clue. I saw you use such musical Arts more than once in Zwillingstürme.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Well, I hate to admit it...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: But you've learned a whole lot of my secrets, Fede.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Wait, you...?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Did our executor here not tell you that I am his beloved soror, Sister Hildegard?

spans.text: Did our executor here not tell you that I am his beloved

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You are my distant relative. And that does not impede me from exercising oversight over you.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Before I brought you back to Laterano, on the outskirts of Zwillingstürme, I warned you—

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I will increase my vigilance over you in order to determine the subjective motivations and possible objective consequences of your actions.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: And I will shoot to kill if I find anything suspicious.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I remember the sunset that day.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: So hardheaded he's fun, isn't he, Sister Hildegard?

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: You were always cooperative, Arturia. That's why Landen Monastery gave you a degree of leeway.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: You deceived us!

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I apologize, Sister.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I hope my impertinence will not be detrimental to you or to Landen Monastery.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Why did you leave Landen Monastery without permission, Arturia?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Look at this shrine, Fede.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: So vast, so full of vitality. It reaches into the clouds, surpassing even the eponymous twin towers of Zwillingstürme in Leithanien...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Is this the 'grace' and 'authority' that Laterano wants to build?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Look at the haloless outsiders being guided inside.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: What are Laterano's plans for them?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: What have you found, Arturia?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Do you remember our short stay at Rhodes Island before returning to Laterano?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I met a mysterious guest there, who told me that there may come a day when Laterano is no longer a warm, cozy little cottage for the Sanktas.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Fede, Sister Hildegard. Look at what lies before you. Do you not suspect that the day has come?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: What has become of the Holy City that we were so proud of?

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Wh-What do you mean?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You are ever vigilant, Fede. You must have noticed something, no?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Otherwise, you would have greeted me with the barrel of your gun.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Are those bombs?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: They look pretty powerful.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sis! You're walking again?!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Uh-huh.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hooray!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Was it you that I saw on Via Jovita, and that Amos saw outside the firearms workshop?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: How did you manage to make so many bombs despite the Curia's strict control of explosive materials...? You're as good at this as ever.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Alright. Spit it out, El. What are you trying to do?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Blow up the shrine?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Stop the Nativity?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Or sabotage the whole Summit of Nations?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Stay back, sis.
A massive pillar cuts the light and shadow open. Lemuen stops in her tracks, keeping her distance from Exusiai.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's a cardinal's cassock you're wearing, isn't it?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Does it look good on me?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Totally! It's so cool!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: It was a little loose around the waist when I got it the day before my creation. I had to stay up all night fixing it.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Ugh, I wish I wasn't wearing this for our reunion.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Did you come back by yourself, or do you have friends with you?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hah, you're pumping me for information now?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You're a simple girl, after all. You're not in a school, and this isn't a graduation ceremony. Did you really just decide to liven things up like this on your own?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Who's behind you, and why did they put you up to this?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey, let's try this—'Apple pie with mayonnaise!'

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: 'Had a slice, want another.'

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You remembered!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: When we had a fight that wasn't going anywhere or a secret we didn't want to share, that's our password to set things aside.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I can feel your emotions, El. Agitation, impatience, worry, not even knowing how to explain...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: But my job is to capture the culprits who are trying to sabotage the Summit of Nations. I will file a request with the Curia to personally handle the follow-up to this case.
The Sankta sisters stand off against one another, neither making a single move, nor speaking a single word. It is Lemuen who finally breaks the silence with a sigh.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: *sigh*...
In that instant, Exusiai flies toward her and hugs her tightly.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Now that's the reaction I know from an El in trouble.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I missed you, sis!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: It's been a while. Have you grown?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course not! I was almost an adult when I left Laterano!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You don't have to talk like you're my mom, sis.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Is that what I sound like?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Did you tie your hair yourself? It's coming loose.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Let me tie it for you... still careless as ever.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course, I'm not as good as you at that.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What are you doing here, anyway? Don't tell me you knew I would show up?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Just reviewing the shrine's security measures... I thought it was remarkable enough to see the Matriarch praying for a pregnant Sarkaz...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: And then I ran into you.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Matriarch... pregnant Sarkaz... praying...?)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Could the Nativity be...?)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So you don't know what's in this shrine either?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Oh, is it your turn to pump me for information?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Who taught you to do that?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I didn't turn bad, I promise! The people who're supporting me now—they're a good influence, I promise!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'm not alone, and I'm not being used.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: There's a lot that's wrong here, but it's hard to explain... I need more time.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'll come home after I've done what I have to!
Lemuen ties one last knot with the string, then pushes up slightly so the strand of hair on the side of her sister's head will not come loose so easily.
The next instant, she finds that her arms are empty.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'll leave the disarming of the bombs to you, sis—I mean, Your Eminence!
Lemuen hears the ticking of bomb countdowns in all directions. She looks in the direction where her sister disappeared, but is in no position to give chase.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: She never changes, does she?
